Mapping(address => uint) tracking how much each recipient has already claimed.
Owner address used for signature verification and onlyOwner checks.
Public claim function: verifies owner signature over a Balance struct and transfers the unclaimed delta to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function allowing the owner to overwrite the claimed amount for any recipient.
Internal pure helper that hex-encodes keccak256(abi.encode(Balance)) into a signed message string.
Internal pure helper converting a bytes32 into a 64-character hex string.
Initializes token and tokenOwner, inheriting Ownable.
onlyOwner function delegating ownership transfer to _transferOwnership.
Internal function that validates and writes the new owner address.
View function returning whether _msgSender() equals _owner.
View function returning the current owner address.
Caller of claim, compared against _balances.recipient and used as the transfer recipient.
External call token.transferFrom(tokenOwner, msg.sender, toClaim) after state update ordering assumptions.
ecrecover-based signature recovery used to authenticate the owner-signed Balance.
Arithmetic SafeMath subtraction _balances.value.sub(claimed[recipient]) producing toClaim.
State write claimed[recipient] = _balances.value used for replay protection.
Balance struct (recipient, value) supplied by the caller of claim.
Signature v component passed to claim.
Signature r component passed to claim.
Signature s component passed to claim.
Balance struct supplied by the owner to doOverride.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
Local string produced by prepareMessage and fed into signature recovery.

Local uint delta between signed value and already claimed amount.

edges.reason: Balance struct argument flows into claim's execution.
Signature v is an input to claim.
Signature r is an input to claim.
Signature s is an input to claim.
Balance struct argument flows into doOverride.
newOwner argument flows into transferOwnership.
_balances is abi-encoded and hashed inside prepareMessage.
prepareMessage returns the signed message string stored in messageSigned.
messageSigned is passed to StringLibrary.recover for signature verification.
v is passed to signature recovery.
r is passed to signature recovery.
s is passed to signature recovery.
recover returns the recovered signer stored in ownerOf.
require(ownerOf == owner()) gates claim on the signature being from the owner.
_owner state variable is the reference value for the signature-owner check.
_balances.recipient is copied into the local recipient variable.
msg.sender is compared against the signed recipient before payout.
The msg.sender == recipient branch guards execution of the payout path in claim.
claimed[recipient] is read and subtracted from the signed value.
_balances.value is the minuend in the SafeMath subtraction.
Subtraction result is stored in toClaim.
toClaim is the amount passed to token.transferFrom.
state_var token is the external contract invoked by transferFrom.
tokenOwner is the 'from' argument of the payout transferFrom.
msg.sender is the 'to' argument of the external transfer call.
claim performs an external token call, exposing the reentrancy surface.
claimed[recipient] is written to _balances.value to prevent replay.
doOverride writes claimed[_balances.recipient] = _balances.value.
onlyOwner modifier controls who may overwrite claimed balances.
newOwner flows through transferOwnership into _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _balances is an input parameter of claim and should be collapsed into its owning function node.
v is only consumed by the signature-recovery unsafe operation.
r is only consumed by the signature-recovery unsafe operation.
s is only consumed by the signature-recovery unsafe operation.
_balances is the sole input parameter of doOverride.
newOwner is the sole input parameter of transferOwnership.
messageSigned is a transient local only used as the input of signature recovery.
ownerOf is a transient local used solely for the owner-authentication check.
recipient is a transient local derived from _balances and used in the payout call.
toClaim is a transient local arithmetic result consumed as the transfer amount.
